## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Password must meet minimum length requirement | validation | len(password) < setting.MinPasswordLength |
| Password must meet complexity requirements | validation | !password_module.IsComplexEnough(password) |
| Password must not be in pwned database | validation | password_module.IsPwned(ctx, password) returns error |
| Cannot remove admin status from last admin user | authorization | IsAdmin=false and user_model.IsLastAdminUser(ctx, u) |
| Password change deletes all auth tokens (forces re-login) | business_logic | Password was changed successfully |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Password shorter than MinPasswordLength | 400 | error message | True |
| Password not complex enough | 400 | error message | True |
| Password found in breach database | 400 | error message | True |
| Email already in use | 400 | error message | False |
| Removing admin from last admin | 400 | error message | False |

### Error Paths

- **Password too short** → admin.EditUser → 400
- **Password not complex** → admin.EditUser → 400
- **Password pwned** → admin.EditUser → 400
- **Email invalid/already used** → admin.EditUser → 400
- **Last admin user removal** → admin.EditUser → 400
